status: REAL published numbers, transcribed by hand; every value is rounded as printed
licence: CC BY 4.0 (arXiv licence of the paper)
definitions: accuracy = c/(c+p+i+a); hallucination_rate = i/(p+i+a); Omniscience Index = 100*(c-i)/(c+p+i+a), i.e. right +1, wrong -1, abstain 0 (paper sec. 2.4)
prompt_note: Every model got the same system prompt (Appendix A.1): '... it is better that you say this than get the wrong answer.' No numeric penalty was stated and no no-instruction baseline is reported.
